session: who tested it and how, e.g. a practicing physical therapist ... over a recorded video call (26 minutes)
pains: her biggest admin pains, in her words
admin_time: e.g. about 2 hours a day = 10 hours a week
ran: what she ran in the app
not_measured: what this session did not measure
quote: her closing sentence (verbatim; use … for cuts)
quote_short: a shorter version for the executive summary
minutes_basis: how the minutes were obtained; read as 'minutes per task are <this>'
